legalCitations.description: Certification in lieu of oath — 'I certify that the foregoing statements made by me are true. I am aware that if any of the foregoing statements made by me are willfully false, I am subject to punishment.' Accepted for court submissions in lieu of a notarized affidavit.
Affidavits — requirements for sworn affidavits in court proceedings; oath or affirmation administered to affiant before an authorized officer
Perjury — knowingly making a false statement under oath or equivalent affirmation when the statement is material to the proceeding; criminal penalty for false affidavit statements
Affidavits — oath or affirmation administered to affiant; written and signed under penalty of perjury
Notary public authority — power to administer oaths, take affidavits, and take acknowledgments; notary must include county of commission and expiration date

exhibitRules.instructions: Label exhibits sequentially (Exhibit A, Exhibit B, etc.) and attach a cover page for each exhibit identifying the exhibit letter and description. Exhibits must be referenced in the body of the affidavit or certification.
